evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Medical visual question answering (VQA) requires acquiring useful evidence and deciding where to look next.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Experiments with 4B and 8B backbones on six medical VQA benchmarks demonstrate improved accuracy, strong out-of-distribution generalization, and substantially lower inference costs.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Our content-controlled estimator compares next actions induced by real and matched alternative observations under a shared real-observation history, isolating how observed content improves subsequent decisions.
